name: One-Skillet Pesto Mozzarella Chicken
ingredients_verbatim: 1 1/2 pounds boneless skinless chicken breasts (or 4 chicken cutlets)
1 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, divided
3 tablespoons Delallo Private Reserve Extra Virgin Olive Oil, divided
1 6 ounce jar Delallo Simply Pesto Traditional Basil
unmapped: basil pesto (6 oz jar) - signature ingredient, likely no board home; flagged for pricer lane
fresh mozzarella (sliced) - board may only carry shredded mozzarella
why: Genuine one-pan stovetop chicken saute (chicken seared, tomatoes/zucchini sauteed, pesto stirred in, mozzarella melted on top in the skillet) - squarely in the chicken-skillet lane and distinct from the run's creamy-garlic/tuscan/marsala/greek chicken skillets. Published 417 cal / 44 g protein / 5 g carbs per serving clears the 400-650 cal and <=35 g carb band with huge carb headroom (meat + olive oil + pesto + cheese + non-starchy veg, zero starch base). High protein relative to calories. Batch-scalable to 14 (weigh-and-divide skillet). Carries an intentional unmapped signature ingredient (jarred basil pesto) to exercise the pricer lane.
confidence: high - read published nutrition and full ingredient list directly from source page; only minor risk our label-DB compute of a 6 oz pesto jar + 3 tbsp oil pushes calories above 417, but still well inside the band
